content: उपशमः .²1 Becoming quiet, assuagement, pacification; कुतोऽस्या उपशमः <ls>Ve. 3</ls>; मन्युर्दुःसह एष यात्युपशमं नो सान्त्ववादैः स्फुटम् <ls>Amaru. 6</ls>; cessation, stopping, extinction. .²2 Relaxation, intermission. .²3 Tranquility, calmness, patience; उपशमशीलाः परमर्षयः <ls>Bhāg. 5. 4. 27</ls>. उपशमायनेषु स्वतनयेषु <ls>Bhāg. 5. 1. 29</ls>. ज्ञानस्योपशमः <ls>Bh. 2. 82</ls>. .²4 Control or restraint of the senses. .²5 (in <ab>Astron.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of the twentieth Muhūrta.
